title: Readers of The Sacred Mushroom find mushrooms in their backyards

tellings.quote: even met Puharic people who read his book uh the sacred mushroom and within uh days of reading his book they find these mushrooms growing in their backyard.

plain: Andrija Puharich, a scientist who wrote a book called The Sacred Mushroom, is said to have met readers who, within days of reading it, found those very mushrooms growing in their own backyards. Jeffrey Mishlove, who holds a PhD and studies psychic claims, tells Michels this as something passed on from Puharich. If true, it would suggest a strange, meaningful link between reading the book and what turned up in readers' lives.
